notes.subject: prayer to Yawe
notes.rationale: Direct petition: 'turn to me and be gracious' — the speaker asks God to act

notes.subject: כמשפט
notes.rationale: 'as is your custom/judgment' — kjv 'as thou usest to do'; rendered 'as is your way'

notes.subject: sɔrɔ
notes.rationale: 'who have/find your name in love' — Bambara needs a verb where Hebrew participle suffices

translation: Yɛlɛ i ɲɛ n na, i dugaw n ma, i n'a fɔ i ka cogo ye minnu bɛ i tɔgɔ sɔrɔ kanuya la.

tokens.gloss: i n'a fɔ i ka cogo ye
